name: Skilled Worker visa
description: Case type for deciding Skilled Worker visa applications, including out-of-country entry clearance, in-country switching, extensions, updates after job or employer change, and linked dependant applications.

decision_gates.title: Application completeness and route selection
decision_gates.check: Application must be submitted on the correct Skilled Worker track with core identity, sponsor and job details present, including employer name, sponsor licence number, certificate of sponsorship reference, job title, salary and occupation code.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Core application information missing or incorrect for Skilled Worker route assessment.
exemptions: Alternative identity and nationality document may be accepted instead of a passport where permitted.

decision_gates.title: Approved sponsor
decision_gates.check: Employer must be approved by the Home Office and sponsor details must match sponsorship records.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Employer is not approved by the Home Office or sponsor licence details do not match.

decision_gates.title: Valid certificate of sponsorship
decision_gates.check: Applicant must have a certificate of sponsorship reference linked to the sponsoring employer and consistent with the application details for role, salary and occupation code.
decision_gates.fail_reason: No valid certificate of sponsorship or certificate details are inconsistent with the application.

decision_gates.title: Confirmed eligible job
decision_gates.check: Applicant must have a confirmed job offer and the role must be on the list of eligible occupations using the correct 4-digit occupation code.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Job offer is not confirmed or the occupation code is not eligible for the Skilled Worker route.

decision_gates.title: Salary threshold assessment
decision_gates.check: Salary must meet the applicable threshold: normally the higher of £41,700 or the going rate, or where applicable a reduced threshold of at least £33,400, £37,500, or £25,000 for some healthcare or education jobs, subject to the relevant going rate and route conditions.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Salary is below the applicable Skilled Worker threshold.
exemptions: Reduced salary route at 70% to 90% of the going rate where salary is at least £33,400 and the applicant meets a listed concession such as age, study status, recent graduate status, professional training, relevant STEM PhD or postdoctoral role.
Relevant non-STEM PhD route where salary is at least £37,500.
Some healthcare or education jobs where salary is at least £25,000 or the higher going rate.
Pre-4 April 2024 sponsorship transitional rules where the applicant meets both transitional conditions, noting exact lower salary figures are not available in the analysis.
Different salary rules may apply for extensions, updates after job or employer change, and switching to become a prison officer.

decision_gates.title: English language requirement
decision_gates.check: Applicant must be able to speak, read, write and understand English and must provide acceptable evidence unless they already proved English in a previous successful visa application.
decision_gates.fail_reason: English language requirement not met or not evidenced.
exemptions: Applicant already proved English in a previous successful visa application.
Accepted qualification route or approved English test route evidenced.

decision_gates.title: Maintenance and conditional evidence
decision_gates.check: Where employer support is not shown on the certificate of sponsorship, applicant must evidence at least £1,270 in personal savings; TB certificate, criminal record certificate and dependant relationship evidence must also be present where route conditions require them.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Required conditional evidence is missing, including maintenance, TB, criminal record or relationship evidence.
exemptions: Bank statements not required where the certificate of sponsorship shows the employer can support the applicant.
TB certificate only required if the applicant is from a listed country.
Criminal record certificate only required for roles where the route requires it.
Relationship evidence only required for dependant partner or child applications.

decision_gates.title: Sponsor compliance and work conditions
decision_gates.check: Employer must comply with minimum wage and working time rules for the sponsored role.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Employer does not meet minimum wage or working time rules.

decision_gates.title: Track-specific in-country conditions
decision_gates.check: For extension cases, applicant should usually remain in the same job and occupation code as previously granted; for update cases, a fresh application is required where employer changes or occupation code changes unless within a graduate training programme; for switching cases, applicant must not travel outside the UK, Ireland, the Channel Islands or the Isle of Man before decision.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Track-specific Skilled Worker conditions are not met.
exemptions: Occupation code change may not require update where the applicant is in a graduate training programme.
Different salary rules may apply for extensions and updates.
Travel-related validity consequences are not fully stated in the analysis and require caseworker review.

decision_gates.title: Decision readiness
decision_gates.check: All mandatory checks completed, identity route confirmed, biometrics captured where required, and no unresolved evidential or compliance concerns remain.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Case is not ready for decision because required checks remain outstanding.

state_transitions.trigger: All checks complete and recommendation prepared
Application withdrawn or treated as withdrawn before assignment
Application withdrawn or treated as withdrawn after assignment
Application withdrawn or treated as withdrawn during review
Application withdrawn or treated as withdrawn while awaiting evidence

evidence_checklist.name: Certificate of Sponsorship reference
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check certificate of sponsorship reference against Home Office sponsorship systems and confirm employer name, sponsor licence number, job title, salary and occupation code match the application.

evidence_checklist.name: Valid passport
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required unless another accepted identity and nationality document is used instead.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Verify identity through the UK Immigration: ID Check app or by checking the passport at a visa application centre and linking it to biometric capture where required.
evidence_checklist.validity_period: Must be valid at time of application

evidence_checklist.name: Alternative identity and nationality document
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Use only where an alternative identity and nationality document is accepted instead of a passport.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Verify identity through the app or biometric appointment and confirm document is accepted for identity and nationality purposes.

evidence_checklist.name: English language evidence
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Usually required unless English was already proved in a previous successful visa application.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check whether the applicant relies on previous proof, a UK school qualification, a UK degree taught in English, an overseas degree taught in English, or an approved English test, and confirm the route is acceptable.

evidence_checklist.name: Biometric information
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required where the applicant is instructed to attend a visa application centre instead of using the app-only route.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Confirm fingerprints and photo were captured at the visa application centre and linked to the application record.

evidence_checklist.name: Bank statements for maintenance funds
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required where the certificate of sponsorship does not show employer support for maintenance.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Review statements to confirm at least £1,270 in personal savings is evidenced, noting the analysis does not provide a holding period rule.

evidence_checklist.name: Tuberculosis test certificate
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required if the applicant is from a listed country.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check TB evidence from approved testing arrangements and confirm the applicant falls within the TB testing requirement.

evidence_checklist.name: Criminal record certificate
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required if the role is one for which a criminal record certificate is required under the route rules.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Review certificate from the relevant authority and confirm whether the occupation triggers the requirement, noting the analysis does not list the occupations.

evidence_checklist.name: Partner relationship evidence
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required for dependant partner applications linked to the main Skilled Worker applicant.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Review relationship evidence submitted with the dependant application and confirm the relationship to the main applicant.

evidence_checklist.name: Child relationship evidence
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required for dependant child applications linked to the main Skilled Worker applicant.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Review relationship evidence submitted with the dependant application and confirm the child relationship to the main applicant.

evidence_checklist.name: Employer letter confirming role details where discrepancies exist
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Request where certificate of sponsorship, salary, occupation code or job title details are inconsistent or where a reduced salary concession needs clarification from the sponsor.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Cross-check employer confirmation against sponsorship records, application data and salary assessment.

evidence_checklist.name: Accommodation or support evidence for dependant circumstances
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Only request where dependant circumstances or maintenance arrangements need clarification beyond the certificate of sponsorship and declared funds.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Review supporting evidence to clarify living and support arrangements where relevant to case credibility or maintenance assessment.

correspondence_templates.name: Acknowledgement of Application
correspondence_templates.subject: Skilled Worker visa application received – {{ case_reference }}
correspondence_templates.body:
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

We have received your Skilled Worker visa application.

Your reference number is {{ case_reference }}.

We will consider the information and documents you have provided for the {{ application_track }} track. This includes checks on your sponsor, certificate of sponsorship, occupation code, salary, English language evidence and any conditional evidence required for your circumstances.

If you need to prove your identity, you must follow the route shown in your application account. This may be through the UK Immigration: ID Check app or by attending a visa application centre to provide your fingerprints and photograph.

If we need more information, we will contact you. Please do not send additional documents unless we ask for them.

Our current service target for this case type in this system is {{ sla_days }} working days from receipt, although actual published processing times are not available in the source policy analysis used to configure this case type.

Relevant policy references: SW-ELIG-01, SW-SPONSOR-01, SW-SPONSOR-02, SW-ID-01.

If you are switching to this route from inside the UK, you must not travel outside the UK, Ireland, the Channel Islands or the Isle of Man while your application is being decided.

Yours sincerely,
UK Visas and Immigration
Home Office

correspondence_templates.name: Evidence Request
correspondence_templates.subject: Further information required for your Skilled Worker visa application – {{ case_reference }}
correspondence_templates.body:
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

We are considering your Skilled Worker visa application and need further information before we can make a decision.

Please provide the following within 28 calendar days of the date of this email:

{{ numbered_evidence_list }}

You can upload documents through your application account unless we tell you to provide them in another way.

The information requested relates to the requirements under policy references {{ policy_reference_codes }}. Depending on your case, this may include sponsor evidence, English language evidence, maintenance evidence, tuberculosis evidence, criminal record evidence, or relationship evidence for dependants.

If you do not provide the requested information by {{ evidence_deadline_date }}, we may decide your application on the information already available. This may result in refusal if the requirements are not met.

If you are switching in the UK, you must not travel outside the UK, Ireland, the Channel Islands or the Isle of Man before a decision is made.

Yours sincerely,
UK Visas and Immigration
Home Office

correspondence_templates.name: Decision: Approved
correspondence_templates.subject: Decision on your Skilled Worker visa application – {{ case_reference }}

correspondence_templates.name: Decision: Refused
correspondence_templates.subject: Decision on your Skilled Worker visa application – {{ case_reference }}
correspondence_templates.body:
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

We have decided to refuse your Skilled Worker visa application.

Application reference: {{ case_reference }}
Decision date: {{ decision_date }}

Reasons for refusal:
{{ refusal_reasons }}

In reaching this decision, we considered the evidence you provided against the relevant Skilled Worker route requirements, including the following policy references where applicable: SW-SPONSOR-01, SW-SPONSOR-02, SW-JOB-01, SW-SALARY-01, SW-ENGLISH-01, SW-EVID-01, SW-EVID-02, SW-EVID-03, SW-SPONSOR-03, SW-TRACK-01.

Examples of refusal grounds under this route include:
- employer not approved by the Home Office
- no valid certificate of sponsorship
- job not on the eligible occupation list
- salary below the applicable threshold or going rate
- employer not meeting minimum wage or working time rules
- English language requirement not met
- insufficient supporting evidence

If you are outside the UK and have a right of appeal, any appeal must usually be brought within 28 calendar days of the date you receive this decision.
If you are inside the UK and have a right of appeal, any appeal must usually be brought within 14 calendar days of the date you receive this decision.

If an administrative review is available for your decision, the review request must be made by the deadline stated in the decision notice issued with your case. The source analysis used for this case type did not provide route-specific administrative review detail, so caseworkers must ensure the correct review wording is inserted before issue.

Yours sincerely,
UK Visas and Immigration
Home Office

correspondence_templates.name: Chase for Missing Evidence
correspondence_templates.subject: Reminder: outstanding documents for your Skilled Worker visa application – {{ case_reference }}
correspondence_templates.body:
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

This is a reminder that we are still waiting for the following documents or information for your Skilled Worker visa application:

{{ outstanding_evidence_list }}

Please provide these by {{ evidence_deadline_date }}.

If you do not respond by the deadline, we may decide your application using the information already available. This may lead to refusal if we cannot be satisfied that you meet the route requirements.

Relevant policy references: {{ policy_reference_codes }}.

If you are switching in the UK, you must not travel outside the UK, Ireland, the Channel Islands or the Isle of Man before a decision is made.

Yours sincerely,
UK Visas and Immigration
Home Office

risk_factors.name: Previous visa refusals
risk_factors.trigger: Applicant discloses previous UK or overseas immigration refusals, or case records show prior refusals relevant to credibility or compliance.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Review refusal history, compare with current declarations, and assess whether any non-disclosure, credibility issue or repeated ineligibility pattern requires escalation.

risk_factors.name: Previous overstaying or leave breach
risk_factors.trigger: Case records indicate previous overstaying, breach of conditions, or adverse compliance history in the UK.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Review immigration history in full, confirm whether any validity or suitability concerns arise, and escalate for senior review where material.

risk_factors.name: Sponsor compliance concern
risk_factors.trigger: Employer is not approved, sponsor licence details do not match, or sponsor records raise concerns about compliance.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Verify sponsor status in Home Office systems, compare licence details with the application and certificate of sponsorship, and escalate if sponsor integrity is in doubt.

risk_factors.name: Certificate of sponsorship inconsistency
risk_factors.trigger: Certificate of sponsorship reference, employer name, salary, job title or occupation code does not align across the application and sponsor systems.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Cross-check all sponsorship fields, request clarification or employer letter if needed, and consider refusal if inconsistency is not resolved.

risk_factors.name: Salary below applicable threshold
risk_factors.trigger: Declared salary appears below £41,700, £33,400, £37,500, £25,000 or the relevant going rate, depending on the claimed route.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Identify the correct salary regime, verify the going rate and concession claimed, and refuse if the threshold is not met.

risk_factors.name: Unsupported reduced salary concession
risk_factors.trigger: Applicant claims a reduced salary route but provides no evidence of age, study status, recent graduate status, professional training, relevant PhD or postdoctoral role.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Request supporting evidence and reassess against the standard threshold if the concession is not evidenced.

risk_factors.name: Healthcare or education concession mismatch
risk_factors.trigger: Applicant relies on healthcare or education salary rules but the role may not fall within the relevant covered jobs.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Confirm whether the role is one of the healthcare or education jobs covered by the route and apply the correct salary rule.

risk_factors.name: Financial irregularities or missing maintenance evidence
risk_factors.trigger: Bank statements are missing where employer support is not shown, or submitted financial evidence does not clearly support the declared maintenance position.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Request or review bank statements carefully and confirm whether the maintenance requirement is met.

risk_factors.name: Document authenticity concern
risk_factors.trigger: Identity, English, TB, criminal record or relationship evidence appears altered, inconsistent, unverifiable or otherwise unreliable.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Undertake enhanced verification, record the concern in detail, and escalate to a senior caseworker before decision.

risk_factors.name: Missing TB certificate where required
risk_factors.trigger: Applicant appears to be from a listed country but no TB certificate has been provided.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Confirm whether the TB requirement applies and request evidence or refuse if the requirement remains unmet.

risk_factors.name: Missing criminal record certificate for relevant role
risk_factors.trigger: Role appears to require a criminal record certificate but none has been provided.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Confirm whether the occupation triggers the requirement and request or assess the certificate accordingly.

risk_factors.name: Prohibited travel while switching
risk_factors.trigger: Applicant switching in-country has travelled outside the UK, Ireland, the Channel Islands or the Isle of Man before decision.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Review whether the application remains valid and escalate for case-specific handling because the exact consequence is not fully stated in the source analysis.

risk_factors.name: Unreported employer or occupation code change
risk_factors.trigger: Information suggests the applicant changed employer or occupation code without making the required update application.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Assess whether a fresh update application is required and whether the current application can proceed.

auto_assignment_rules.condition: Straightforward main applicant case with valid sponsor, standard salary threshold met, no conditional evidence gaps, and total risk score 0 to 10.
auto_assignment_rules.reason: Standard Skilled Worker applications can be handled by general work routes caseworkers.

auto_assignment_rules.condition: Case involves reduced salary concession, healthcare or education salary rules, or pre-4 April 2024 transitional salary assessment.
auto_assignment_rules.reason: Salary-rule exceptions require more detailed route knowledge and careful threshold assessment.

auto_assignment_rules.condition: Case includes sponsor mismatch, document authenticity concerns, previous overstaying, previous refusals with credibility concerns, or total risk score 21 or above.
auto_assignment_rules.reason: High-risk or potentially adverse cases require senior oversight before decision.

auto_assignment_rules.condition: In-country switching case with evidence of prohibited travel before decision or uncertainty about application validity.
auto_assignment_rules.reason: Travel-related switching issues may affect validity and require senior review.

auto_assignment_rules.condition: Dependant application linked to a main applicant case where relationship evidence is incomplete or inconsistent.
auto_assignment_rules.reason: Linked dependant decisions require coordinated assessment of relationship evidence and end-date alignment.

policy_references.title: Core Skilled Worker application requirements
policy_references.criteria: Application must be made on the correct Skilled Worker track with core sponsor, job and identity information present.

policy_references.title: Approved Home Office sponsor requirement
policy_references.criteria: Applicant must work for a UK employer approved by the Home Office.

policy_references.title: Certificate of Sponsorship requirement
policy_references.criteria: Applicant must have a valid certificate of sponsorship reference linked to the sponsoring employer and consistent with the application.

policy_references.title: Minimum wage and working time compliance
policy_references.criteria: Employer must ensure the job pays at least the minimum wage and complies with UK working time rules; non-compliance leads to refusal.

policy_references.title: Sponsor clarification evidence
policy_references.criteria: Where sponsor data is inconsistent or incomplete, additional employer confirmation may be requested to verify role, salary and occupation details.

policy_references.title: Eligible occupation and confirmed job offer
policy_references.criteria: Applicant must have a confirmed job offer and the role must be on the list of eligible occupations using the correct 4-digit occupation code.

policy_references.title: Salary threshold and going rate assessment
policy_references.criteria: Salary must meet the applicable threshold: normally the higher of £41,700 or the going rate, or an applicable reduced threshold such as £33,400, £37,500 or £25,000 where route conditions allow.

policy_references.title: English language requirement
policy_references.criteria: Applicant must be able to speak, read, write and understand English and must provide acceptable evidence unless exempt because English was already proved in a previous successful visa application.

policy_references.title: Identity and nationality evidence
policy_references.criteria: Applicant must provide a valid passport or other accepted identity and nationality document and complete the required identity verification route.

policy_references.title: Biometric enrolment where required
policy_references.criteria: Applicant must provide fingerprints and a photograph at a visa application centre where instructed instead of using the app-only route.

policy_references.title: Maintenance and conditional evidence
policy_references.criteria: Applicant must provide maintenance evidence where employer support is not shown on the certificate of sponsorship, and must provide any other conditional evidence required by their circumstances.

policy_references.title: Tuberculosis evidence requirement
policy_references.criteria: Applicant must provide tuberculosis test results where they are from a listed country and the route requires TB evidence.

policy_references.title: Criminal record certificate requirement
policy_references.criteria: Applicant must provide a criminal record certificate where the role falls within the occupations for which the route requires one.

policy_references.title: Dependant relationship evidence
policy_references.criteria: Partner and child dependants must make separate applications and provide evidence of their relationship to the main applicant.

policy_references.title: Dependant end-date alignment and support assessment
policy_references.criteria: Where dependant applications are granted, permission will usually end on the same date as the main applicant's visa; additional support evidence may be reviewed where relevant.

policy_references.title: Track-specific extension, update and switching rules
policy_references.criteria: Extensions usually require the same job and occupation code; updates are required for employer or occupation code changes unless an exception applies; switching applicants must not travel outside the permitted area before decision.

policy_references.title: Decision readiness and outcome recording
policy_references.criteria: Decision can only be made once identity, sponsorship, salary, English and all required conditional evidence checks are complete and recorded.
